name: Bloodfury Trinkets
summary: Mor'rogal asks you to bring him the glittering sunstones collected by Bloodfury harpies in the Charred Vale. He says the stones hold a connection to the lights of the skies.

sections.title: Harpies' Stones
sections.body: The Bloodfury harpies gather shiny objects, including golden-yellow sunstones. Mor'rogal, up on the hills above you, has mentioned using them. He asks you to bring him any Glittering Sunstones you find.

sections.title: Light in Stone
sections.body: Mor'rogal says the sunstones reflect the sun's majesty and can adorn shrines and homes with small motes of light. At night, the moon gives them its silver beauty. To him, they are a reminder of a bond with the lights of the skies.

faq.q: What are the Bloodfury harpies collecting?
faq.answer: The Bloodfury harpies collect shiny objects, including golden-yellow sunstones.
Mor'rogal, who is up on the hills above you, has mentioned using sunstones.

faq.q: What does Mor'rogal use sunstones for?
faq.answer: He says they can adorn shrines and homes with small motes of light.

faq.q: What do the sunstones mean to Mor'rogal?
faq.answer: They remind him of a connection to the lights of the skies.
